create_ctw_predictor: create a CTWPredictor instance with configurable depth, batched update, and max capacity
train_ctw_model: train the CTW model by calling update with sequences to learn conditional probabilities
predict_ctw_sequence: predict log-probabilities for sequences using the trained CTW predictor
build_context_tree: build context trees for CTW by constructing contexts from sequence history with configurable depth
summarize_ctw_algorithm: summarize the Context Tree Weighting algorithm for multi-alphabet sequence prediction
